work.title: Reaper, Snowman
work.description: Stenciled street art on a weathered concrete wall depicts a hooded, skull-faced figure in dark tones with a small ankh symbol at the chest, facing forward. Upper-left registers two stacked circles forming a simplified snowman with dot markings; scattered tags and paint residue surround both figures.
work.composition: central reaper stencil with snowman row at upper left
